query.text:
if dbo.FastBusiness$Function$CheckSQLInjection(@stt_rec) = 0 return
declare @m_ma_nt0 varchar(10), @bilingual tinyint, @l char(1), @ngay_tu smalldatetime, @ngay_den smalldatetime, @ngay_ct smalldatetime, @beginDate smalldatetime, @yearValue varchar(32), @nam int, @loai_dl char(1) declare @consolidatingGroup char(16), @periodCode char(8), @periodName nvarchar(128), @periodName2 nvarchar(128), @periodType char(1), @companyParent char(8), @dataTypeName nvarchar(128), @dataTypeName2 nvarchar(128) declare @ten_cty nvarchar(512), @ten_cty2 nvarchar(512), @dia_chi nvarchar(1024), @ten_ktt nvarchar(512) declare @day_month_from nvarchar(8), @day_month_to nvarchar(8), @day int, @month int, @day2 int, @month2 int, @day3 int, @month3 int, @i int, @s varchar(8), @s2 varchar(8), @yearReport int, @yearReport2 int
if @@form in ('011', '111') select @bilingual = 1, @l = 'V' else select @bilingual = 0, @l = @@language select @m_ma_nt0 = val from options where name = 'm_ma_nt0'
select @consolidatingGroup = nhom_hn, @periodCode = ma_ky, @nam = nam, @loai_dl = loai_dl from cfphdc1 a with(nolock) where stt_rec = @stt_rec
select top 1 @periodType = loai_ky, @periodName = ten_ky, @periodName2 = ten_ky2, @day_month_from = rtrim(ltrim(ngay_tu)), @day_month_to = rtrim(ltrim(ngay_den)) from cfdmky where ma_ky = @periodCode select @beginDate = ngay_dn2 from dmstt select @yearValue = case when day(@beginDate) = 1 and month(@beginDate) = 1 then rtrim(@nam) else rtrim(@nam) + ' - ' + rtrim(@nam + 1) end, @day3 = day(@beginDate), @month3 = month(@beginDate), @yearReport = @nam, @yearReport2 = @nam
if @periodType = 1 select @periodName = '', @periodName2 = '' select @i = charindex('/', @day_month_from), @day = left(@day_month_from, @i-1), @month = right(@day_month_from, len(@day_month_from) - @i), @i = charindex('/', @day_month_to), @day2 = left(@day_month_to, @i-1), @month2 = right(@day_month_to, len(@day_month_to) - @i)
if not (@month >= @month3 or (@day3 = 1 and @month3 = 1)) select @yearReport = @yearReport + 1 if not (@month2 >= @month3 or (@day3 = 1 and @month3 = 1)) select @yearReport2 = @yearReport2 + 1
select @s = rtrim(@yearReport) + replace(str(@month, 2), ' ', '0') + replace(str(@day, 2), ' ', '0'), @s2 = rtrim(@yearReport2) + replace(str(@month2, 2), ' ', '0') + replace(str(@day2, 2), ' ', '0') if isdate(@s) = 0 and @month = 2 and @day = 29 set @s = rtrim(@yearReport) + '0228' if isdate(@s2) = 0 and @month2 = 2 and @day2 = 29 set @s2 = rtrim(@yearReport2) + '0228' select @ngay_tu = case when isdate(@s) = 1 then convert(smalldatetime, @s) else null end, @ngay_den = case when isdate(@s2) = 1 then convert(smalldatetime, @s2) else null end
select @companyParent = ma_cty_me from cfdmnhomhn where ma_nh = @consolidatingGroup
select @ten_cty = ten_cty, @ten_cty2 = ten_cty2, @dia_chi = dia_chi, @ten_ktt = ten_ktt from cfdmcty where ma_cty = @companyParent
select @dataTypeName = case when @loai_dl = '1' then case when @l = 'v' then N'Trước kiểm toán' else N'Pre-Audit' end else case when @l = 'v' then N'Sau kiểm toán' else N'Audited' end end select @dataTypeName2 = case when @loai_dl = '1' then case when @l = 'v' then N'Pre-Audit' else N'Trước kiểm toán' end else case when @l = 'v' then N'Audited' else N'Sau kiểm toán' end end
select @ten_cty as ten_cty, @ten_cty2 as ten_cty2, @dia_chi as dia_chi, @ten_ktt as ten_ktt, isnull(@periodName, '') as ten_ky, isnull(@periodName2, '') as ten_ky2, @yearValue as nien_do, @ngay_tu as ngay_tu, @ngay_den as ngay_den, @dataTypeName as loai_dl, @dataTypeName2 as loai_dl2, nhom_hn, ma_ky, rtrim(nam) as nam_hn, ltrim(so_ct) as so_ct, dien_giai, t_ps_no, t_ps_no_nt, t_ps_co, t_ps_co_nt, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, t_ps_no, @l) as t_ps_no_in_word, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_ps_no_nt, @l) as t_ps_no_nt_in_word, case when @bilingual = 1 then dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, t_ps_no, 'E') else '' end as t_ps_no_in_word2, case when @bilingual = 1 then dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_ps_no_nt, 'E') else '' end as t_ps_no_nt_in_word2, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(@m_ma_nt0, t_ps_co, @@language) as t_ps_co_in_word, dbo.FastBusiness$Function$System$ReadCurrency(ma_nt, t_ps_co_nt, @@language) as t_ps_co_nt_in_word, replace(str(day(ngay_ct),2),' ','0') ngay, replace(str(month(ngay_ct),2),' ','0') thang, cast(year(ngay_ct) as char(4)) nam from cfphdc1 a with(nolock) where stt_rec = @stt_rec
declare @key varchar(128) select @key = 'a.stt_rec = ''' + @stt_rec + '''' exec rs_PrintCFDC1Tran @@language, @key, 'cfctdc1', @@id, @bilingual
&Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Declare; &Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Select; &Conditional.Unit.Profile.Query.Result;
